deadline.value: Completed applications received by January 15 get full consideration; the committee reviews from February.
deadline.quote: All completed applications received by January 15 will receive full consideration.

gre_general.value: Applicants should take the General GRE; the department strongly encourages the Physics subject test for international applicants.
gre_general.quote: Applicants should take the General GRE, and are strongly encouraged to take the Physics GRE subject area test for international applicants.

gre_subject.value: The Physics GRE subject test is strongly encouraged for international applicants; those without it must show other evidence of achievement.
gre_subject.quote: strongly encouraged to take the Physics GRE subject area test for international applicants | Applicants without GRE subject scores must provide other evidence of outstanding achievement and promise.

fee_waiver.value: The Physics Department says its application fee cannot be waived.

toefl_min.value: Physics states a minimum TOEFL iBT of 68, below the graduate school's 80; check this with the department before relying on it.
toefl_min.quote: The preference is to have TOEFL IBT scores sent directly by ETS to the Physics Department. | The minimum acceptable score is 68.

entry_route.value: Admission requires a bachelor's degree; the department also runs a separate master's program.
entry_route.quote: A student must have a bachelor's degree from a college or university regarded as standard by a regional or general accrediting agency.

supervisor.value: Applications are judged by the admissions committee; PhD students work with a faculty advisor after starting.
supervisor.quote: The admissions committee will evaluate completed applications beginning in February and until the program is filled for the upcoming fall semester.

also.quote: Subsequently, they pursue their doctoral research under the guidance of a faculty advisor.

funding.value: The department says it may offer full tuition plus stipend support to PhD students; it does not say most are funded.
funding.quote: The department may offer full tuition plus stipend support to our PhD program’s students.

notes: The graduate school sets TOEFL 80; Physics states 68. No separate astronomy PhD appears on the College of Arts and Sciences doctoral list.
